answer: Map the agent economy as a trust graph and rank it the way SybilRank did at Tuenti. First, seed short random walks from long-standing members. Second, let trust flow only along real vouches, so a fake cluster becomes an island with almost no bridge to the mainland. A 1,000-wallet farm dies by random-walk ranking at 200,000, since SybilRank flagged 200,000 accounts at Tuenti and 90% of them were fake, against a 5% hit rate for user reports. Each voyage of trust stops at the water's edge: fakes can copy each other forever, but they cannot buy a bridge to real members.
